thread:
anya: Heads-up — we started the conditional egress tighten for the keystore (eu-west-1) ~10m ago. Noticing a spike in GPU node bootstrap failures. Thinking rollback unless we can quick-fix. Runbook: https://playbooks.redwood.internal/keystore-egress-tighten
liam: Ugh. How bad? numbers? which pools affected?
devin: ~18% of GPU warm pools failing to finish join. metric: gpu_node_join_fail_rate went 0.18 -> 0.52 after the deny kicked in.
maria: Can we add the warm-pool ENI CIDR (10.4.0.0/22) to the allowlist temporarily?
devin: Tried that but the new IAM condition on the KMS role blocks assumeRole for ephemeral ENIs (condition: aws:SourceIp not in allowed_cidrs). The terraform change landed in the policy earlier today.
liam: Is this the same conditional that was supposed to be gradual? thought scheduled for next week.
anya: It was gated but someone flipped the flag in the pipeline. We're triaging.
sre-oncall: I can flip the firewall rule to permissive for keystore egress in eu-west-1 for 30m while we patch IAM condition. Will do if ops approves.
maria: +1 for permissive for 30m. Need to update the audit log to show temporary exception.
devin: Patch ready that removes the aws:SourceIp requirement and limits by principal tag instead. If we rollback the TF change, nodes should recover. Snippet:
```
# revert conditional on keystore role
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "keystore" {
  # removed aws:SourceIp condition
}
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback request created -> PR #RWD-ops/1127
liam: Also note cost: if we keep permissive, warm pools will stay large and NAT GW egress will rise. Rough estimate +$1.2k/day if permissive >12h.
anya: Opened INC-1234, adding rollback steps & customer-notify template.
sre-oncall: Applying permissive firewall change now.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: firewall rule update applied by sre-oncall (change-id ch_20260321_01)
devin: Re-applying join; monitoring join-rate.
sre-oncall: Confirming: gpu_node_join_fail_rate back down to 0.06 2m after change. Warm pools healing.
liam: Good. We need a postmortem: who flipped flag and why the rollout gating missed. Also add a pre-deploy test that simulates ephemeral ENI assumeRole.
anya: Agreed. I'll schedule a blameless postmortem and publish action items to the infra retro doc.
maria: Will add audit entry showing temporary exception window and attach to INC-1234.
ops-bot: automation: scheduled revert window at +30m if no manual change.
anya: Thanks everyone — closing this thread once postmortem created.
